text: This initiative is the first-of-its-kind parametric earthquake cover for submarine cable systems, offering non-sovereign coverage by a regional catastrophe risk pool. It utilizes open-source seismic models from GEM and objective triggers from USGS to ensure rapid payouts. The policy is strategically aligned with PNG DataCo's role in regional connectivity, complementing large-scale investments in digital infrastructure.

metadata.solution_name: PNG DataCo Parametric Earthquake Insurance for Submarine Fibre-Optic Cable Network
